title: The move into done regenerates the whole knowledge library, churning tracked files in an unrelated change
symptom: chough stage advance from accept to done modified 35 tracked files under knowledge/ and added 39, indexing 34 archived changes main had not indexed.
trigger: chough stage advance accept to done in a repository with many archived native changes and a knowledge library that is behind them.
expected: The move into done writes only its own journal post and the feed entry; every other knowledge file stays byte-identical, because the library only links (KNOW-30, KNOW-31, KNOW-33).
actual: Chough 0.5.0 rebuilt archive, module, intent and timeline notes for every archived change at done (spec-sync repository, seen by the spec-sync worker t38b, relayed by the coordinator on 2026-11-11).
steps: In a repository whose knowledge library lags its archived native changes, advance a session from accept to done.
git status shows dozens of modified and new files under knowledge/.
impact: Unrelated changes carry dozens of generated knowledge files, which collide on a shared repository and blur review.
source: spec-sync repository, Chough 0.5.0, worker t38b; relayed by t370 on 2026-11-11

notes.text: Red on 0.5.0 (t38b, bc802047 on leif/0.6.0-ledger-red): the move into done wrote two other knowledge files from the session roll-up and no journal post.
status: open -> verified. Green on integration: tests/journal.rs done_changes_no_knowledge_file_but_its_own_post_and_the_feed passes; the move into done writes only its own post and the feed lines.
